detail.purpose: Seal when the Solver gains a measurement-only (repro-on-HEAD) attempt path that lets already-committed process quests reach a terminal measuring attempt without a fabricated diff artifact.
detail.metricMeaning: number of blocking quests still unsealable for want of a no-change attempt path (3 -> 0)
acceptance: a measurement-only attempt records done:true against the committed HEAD with an honestly empty source delta
the verifier identity is computed from committed refs and reproduces at land time (no hand-written diff)
the path refuses when the working tree carries uncommitted changes in the claimed paths
at least one of the blocking quests is sealed through the new path, proven by its solve log
npm run lint, npm run steering:check, node scripts/solve.js lint --all --json, npm run solve:consistency all green
